# v2026.11.16

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.11.16.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.11.16.md).

This release covers **3 pull requests.**

## Highlights

- A new price link, a placeholder line or a mapping change now also reaches jobs held from a history import, so their waiting lines take the new code. ([#545](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/545))
- The Seazona history read stays inside Seazona's rate limit, stops after 6 failed runs in a row, and its Copy error leaves out order ids. ([#542](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/542))

## Fixes

- A new price link or mapping also reaches held history jobs. A held history job with a Flow invoice goes to review when its lines change. ([#545](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/545))
- The Seazona history read keeps to the rate limit and gives up after a cap instead of retrying without end. ([#542](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/542))

## Contribution record

[CHANGELOG/records/2026.11.16.md](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/blob/main/CHANGELOG/records/2026.11.16.md) lists every pull request in this release once, with its related issues and thanks.
